Khronos OpenGL ES 2.0 headers
================================

Files: GLES2/gl2.h, GLES2/gl2ext.h, GLES2/gl2platform.h

Source: https://registry.khronos.org/OpenGL/api/GLES2/
        (generated from https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenGL-Registry)

Copyright 2013-2026 The Khronos Group Inc.
SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

These headers are vendored so the port can be compiled on a host that does not
ship GLES2 development packages. They contain no implementation; the device
still links against the driver's libGLESv2.so.2.
